user_feedback_addressed: Wider cards layout: Shift from cramped 3-col 540px grid at 1920px to a comfortable 2-column grid on desktop (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2 2xl:grid-cols-2), giving each tile ~720px-880px width so all names, warehouse breakdowns, and member rows fit with zero awkward wrapping and zero ellipses.
Helvetica font throughout, reduced font clutter with distinct optical hierarchy.
Eliminated all Overdue info as requested, retaining strictly expected next order, expected crates, and crates in hand.
Global stock dashboard conventions respected: rose-700 for short / emerald-700 for covered.
Clear 0 display: When stock is unavailable, explicitly show '0 cr' instead of misleading dashes or blank spaces.
If stock is available, date stays clear/emerald; if stock is short, both expected date and in-hand deficit turn rose-700 with an explicit negative shortfall badge (-X cr).
No date wrapping: Dates formatted as '18 Sep' using whitespace-nowrap.
High density readable sections: 3-column structured forecast command deck inside each tile with light neutral dividers.

grid_and_responsive_spec.rationale: Changing from 3 cols at 1920px (540px width) to 2 cols (850-920px width) gives 60% more horizontal runway. Account names, multi-warehouse splits, shared tags, and member rows fit comfortably on single lines without text ellipsis or truncated numbers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain 100% of the existing React state logic, Axios calls, export URL generator, and filter combinations.
Do NOT reintroduce Overdue metrics or tables; respect the user's explicit request to keep tiles focused strictly on Expected next order vs Branded stock in hand.
Use wider 2-column layout on wide screens (grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2) instead of the narrow 3-column layout so customer names, warehouses, and SKU rows expand freely without ellipses.
All fonts MUST remain Helvetica/Helvetica Neue/Arial sans-serif.
Format all dates as 'DD MMM' without year (e.g., '18 Sep') using whitespace-nowrap so dates never break across lines.

If stock cannot cover next order (low_stock is true), apply rose-700 text to both Next Order date, Expected quantity, and display a negative shortfall badge (-X cr) in In Hand. If stock is covered, keep Next order date and status in emerald-700 or dark neutral.
When stock is unavailable or 0, display '0 cr' explicitly rather than blank or ambiguous symbols.
Brand Group tiles use violet-700 accent with Layers icon and display member rows with status dots (rose-700 if short, emerald-700 if covered, slate-300 if no next order).
Keep all exact data-testid attributes intact so automated tests continue to pass seamlessly.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Wider tiles with generous p-5 sm:p-6 internal padding. Use grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2 for plenty of breathing room.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.touch_targets: Minimum 36px to 40px clickable targets for filters, buttons, and popovers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG compliant contrasts: rose-700 (#B91C1C) on rose-50, emerald-700 (#047857) on emerald-50, slate-900 (#0F172A) on white.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.icons: Use lucide-react exclusively (AlertTriangle, Layers, Store, Users, Search, RefreshCw, FileSpreadsheet, Package, Check, ChevronsUpDown, X).
